title: Limousine Transportation....Round Trip Pick-Up and Drop-Off Special.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Our new Pick-Up and Drop-Off Special now makes round trip Limousine transportation way more affordable. With this rental, you only pay for your transportation, unlike other companies that charge you from start to finish even while you aren't using your limo. This is perfect for dinners, excursions, exploring Hampton Roads, Virginia Beach Town Center Restaurants, Saddler Center, Spirit of Norfolk Cruises, harbor boat tours, Ocean Breeze Water Park, Waterside District, Tides games, Nauticus Museum, kids events and activities, and so much more.
